responsibility: This file implements command-line option handling and option-state storage for the mc front end. It owns the persistent flags and strings controlling target language selection, output naming, preprocessing command and arguments, GPL/header emission, scaffolding modes, debug and quiet/verbose behavior, opaque-type handling, GCC config/system include generation, and related translation toggles; it parses user arguments, provides getters and setters for other modules, and can emit generated license/comment headers, making it the central compiler configuration subsystem.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the stateful implementation behind GmcOptions.h: it owns the option variables, parses arguments, builds derived values such as the preprocessor command line, and emits GPL/header text.
